justification: Changes when the walking lookup refuses a station with no footpath data, what the area card says when a yes carries a warning, and deletes an unused parking calculator route and component.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_lmr_walk_surface.py -q && cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest --testPathPatterns=area-check-card
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a station listed in a walking file but reached by no stored node is accepted as having walking data, or a yes with a warning is shown as a yes with the headline and parking figures
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main services/lmr_walk_surface.py a surface that lists station B with no nodes returns valid=True for required_anchors {A,B} (measured by loading the origin/main file). On origin/main AreaCheckCard.tsx the new card test fails (1 failed, 10 passed in area-check-card).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Before/after answers on 33 lots (25 random across the 5 areas, 8 beside Hornsby and Westmead) were identical, so the change closes a hole without moving any sampled answer. The 200-lot router test was NOT re-run: its judge input (lmr_station_entrances_final.json) needs the TfNSW GTFS Pathways file saved by hand.

pre_impl.existing_data: data/lmr_walk/*.npz: 7 files; 16 of 62 stations have no node in any file (all outside the five areas except Hornsby and Westmead edges)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old check treated every station name in a file's anchor list as built; the Inner West files list 83 names but only 31 to 37 are reached by a node
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Lots near a listed station with no data now answer 'could not be measured' instead of a number
pre_impl.frontend_type: warnings is an array on both result and result.lmr; both are read with optional chaining
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A person near an unbuilt station sees a reason instead of a yes or no

functions.name: walk_from_lot
functions.output: walk metres or invalid with reason
functions.if_none: invalid with reason, never a number

functions.name: AreaCheckCard lead
functions.input: area answer and whether a warning is present
functions.output: one sentence; no yes or no when warned
functions.if_none: failed or no result shows the not-answered card

values.if_missing: treated as no warning from this source; result.warnings still counts

break_it.scenario: a station has two entrances, one with nodes and one without
break_it.how: a name counts as built if any entrance index appears among the node anchors

break_it.scenario: a warning sits only on lmr.warnings, not on the top-level list
break_it.what_happens: the card could still show a yes
break_it.how: the card reads both, the same rule as useAreaCheck inLmrArea

break_it.scenario: the card gets a yes with no warning
break_it.what_happens: it could lose its headline or parking figures
break_it.how: the warned branch only applies when a warning exists; the existing card tests for a plain yes still pass
